step.name: setServerDirectoryPermissions
step.title: Change directory ownership and permissions
step.description: Remove read and execute access for all users to the zFS file system and set group access if required
step.instructions: Remove access to all users from ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}

template.inlineTemplate:
#if(${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} != "" && ${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP}) ownership="${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP}" dirflag=750 fileflag=640 #else ownership="${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}" dirflag=700 fileflag=600 #end
#if(${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} != "" && ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}) echo "Changing ownership of ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} to $ownership" chown -R $ownership ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} echo "Ensure read and write access to ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}" chmod -R u+rw ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} #end
echo "Transfer ownership of ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} to $ownership" chown $ownership ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} chown $ownership ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/server.env chown $ownership ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/jvm.options echo "Change file access to $fileflag" chmod $fileflag ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/server.env chmod $fileflag ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/jvm.options echo "Change directory access to $dirflag" chmod $dirflag ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} if [ -d "${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins" ] then chown $ownership ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins chown $ownership ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins/overrides chmod $dirflag ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins chmod $dirflag ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins/overrides fi
